simple.meaning: שָׁנָא (shânâʼ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to alter.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 3 times in 2 Kings, Ecclesiastes, Lamentations, beginning at 2 Kings 25:29. The surrounding contexts include family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁנָא (H8132) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׁנָא (shânâʼ) / H8132 is traced through 2 Kings 25:29, Ecclesiastes 8:1, Lamentations 4:1 with source-language evidence and verse context.

occurrences.englishText: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life;
Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.
How the gold has become dim!
